archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Dark Technical Readout / Blueprint Command Center)
design_intent: Gridline is an AI-powered takeoff and estimation engine for commercial and multi-family flooring subcontractors. The visual direction is a high-contrast dark technical-readout aesthetic: deep obsidian/slate backgrounds, electric high-visibility neon-yellow (#E2F952 / #D8FA28) glow accents, technical blueprint gridlines (subtle 1px cyan/slate grid overlays), crisp hairline borders, and ultra-readable high-contrast typography designed specifically for clarity and ease of use by older-age contractors and estimator pros.

rules.senior_contractor_friendly: Never use text smaller than 14px for core numbers or inputs. Use high-contrast font weights (600/700) for numeric totals and square footage metrics.

entry_surfaces./: split hero with technical blueprint grid — value proposition + primary CTA left, interactive live takeoff preview & spec calculator right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — system mission + technical readout preview left, login credentials form right
entry_surfaces./signup: branded split auth — system mission + tier selection helper left, registration form right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: command center header + live summary KPI metrics banner + multi-building job list table with status badges and quick takeoff trigger
entry_surfaces./upload: technical blueprint dropzone with drag-and-drop, PDF multi-page stack support (100+ pages), and real-time Opus AI extraction progress stepper
entry_surfaces./takeoffs/:id: high-density hierarchical takeoff workspace grouped by Building and Unit, tap-to-edit line items (flooring type, sqft, waste %, adhesive, labor, cost), AI flag banner, discount & tax bar, and quote/invoice converter
entry_surfaces./invoices: invoicing ledger with quote-to-invoice status, email dispatch status, Pay Now Stripe link generator, and change-order revision log
entry_surfaces./profit: monthly profit summary comparing paid invoices against job expense logs with profit margin metrics and Recharts breakdown
entry_surfaces./billing: three-tier subscription & pay-per-job matrix ($39 Single Job, $99 5-Job Pack, $999/mo Unlimited Pro) with Stripe portal integration
entry_surfaces./settings: tax jurisdiction auto-detector (GST/HST/PST/VAT/Sales Tax) + editable regional overrides, default labor rates, and waste % presets

visual_enhancers.neon_glow_card: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-10 before:rounded-xl before:bg-[#E2F952]/5 before:blur-xl
visual_enhancers.terminal_pill: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono bg-[#1C2712] text-[#E2F952] border border-[#E2F952]/30

motion.principles: Snappy, deterministic transitions that feel like precision engineering tools. Fast micro-interactions (150ms-200ms) with zero sluggishness.
motion.data_table_edit_flash: highlight updated cells with a quick 400ms neon glow flash to confirm saved state
motion.respect_reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential layout shifts with motion/react checking prefers-reduced-motion

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens meet APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum on their respective dark slate/obsidian backgrounds (#090D12, #0F1722, #131D2A).
accessibility.hit_targets: Minimum 44px tap target on all interactive table cells, buttons, filter chips, and dialog actions for ease of use in field/tablet/desktop conditions.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full arrow and tab navigation through editable takeoff spreadsheet cells with Enter to commit and Escape to cancel.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup CSS Theming: Update `frontend/src/index.css` to import `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk` for headings and `@fontsource-variable/dm-sans` for sans, plus `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono` for mono. Ensure `dark` mode is enabled by default with dark background #090D12 and neon accent #E2F952.

2. Build Navigation & Core Pages: Implement Landing Page (`/`), Dashboard (`/dashboard`), Upload (`/upload`), Takeoff View (`/takeoffs/:id`), Invoices & Quotes (`/invoices`), Profit Summary & Expenses (`/profit`), Billing (`/billing`), Settings (`/settings`), Login (`/login`), and Register (`/register`).

3. Implement AI Reading Engine Experience: Build an interactive blueprint upload simulation supporting single & 100+ page blueprints. Include the Claude Opus extraction pipeline stages: Step 1 (Record printed scale & written room dimensions, prioritizing text over visual estimates), Step 2 (Calculate sqft, 12 floor types, waste factors 5%-15%, adhesive recommendations for subfloor type, and labor cost), Step 3 (Cross-check room total vs building stated total and flag unreadable/blurry rooms for manual contractor review).

4. Implement Editable Takeoff Table: Enable full tap-to-edit inline modifications on square footage, floor type (LVP, VCT, Carpet Tile, Broadloom, Ceramic Tile, Epoxy, Hardwood, Sheet Vinyl, Rubber, Terrazzo, Laminate, Polished Concrete), waste %, adhesive type, and labor hours. Provide instant auto-recalculation of totals and tax.

5. Invoicing & Change Order Flow: Add 'Convert to Quote' with discount % & auto-detected tax rates (GST, HST, PST, VAT, State Sales Tax). Add Stripe 'Pay Now' mock/action, email quote delivery, and revision-safe Change Orders (v1.0 -> v1.1) that retain full audit trails without deleting history.

6. Expense Log & Monthly Profit: Provide interactive expense entries (materials, adhesive, labor payouts, haul away) that reconcile automatically against paid invoices into a monthly profit summary chart.
7. Three-Tier Pricing Matrix: Implement Single Job ($39), 5-Job Pack ($99), and Unlimited Pro ($999/mo with 14-day free trial) with clean checkout trigger.
8. Testing Attributes: Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and key summary values have `data-testid` attributes for complete testing agent coverage.
